newsitem.title: USA: Richmond Fed--no clouds on region's horizon - RFTV.
newsitem.headline: Richmond Fed--no clouds on region's horizon - RFTV.

text.p: The economic outlook for the region covered by the Richmond Federal Reserve Bank looks good with "no clouds on the horizon," Bank economist Raymond Owens said on Tuesday.
In an interview with Reuters Financial Television, Owens agreed with the characterization of the outlook as "steady as she goes."
The Richmond Fed reported earlier that its manufacturing shipments and new order indices fell slightly in February.
Owens said that regional price pressures continue to be "very, very modest." The wage picture is mixed, but on the whole the outlook is for steady growth, he added.
He said that the continued weakness in manufacturing has been offset by growth in the more important service sector. On the whole, the regional economy is growing steadily.
"The bright spot is retail sales," Owens said.
Consumer borrowing is "holding up OK," with no major credit problems, he added.
